matchup.plan_title: Plan (20:20 UTC 19 Nov): Rollins is back, so Jones Jr. replaces Jakucionis
matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- Ryan Rollins is available (user, 19 Nov), so Jakucionis's extra minutes are gone. He is left out of every line (`--sit`, 19–22 Nov).
- **Score:** 821 to 777. **Projection with no more moves:** **1,694 to 1,641**; their side fell from 906 to 864 more.
- **Adds:** 5 left.

**The plan: 5 adds, +133.1** (ESPN dates, Melbourne times):
1. **19 Nov:** drop Bamba (no game until 20 Nov). Add **Derrick Jones Jr.** (LAC @SA) before 12:00 PM Fri 20.
   - Jones Jr.: rate 26.0. Season 27.0 (12), L7 25.3 (3), L15 26.2 (6), L30 27.0 (12).
2. **20 Nov:** drop Jones Jr. after his game. Add **Trey Murphy III** before NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
   - Only if NO's report clears him; it is due by about 10:00 AM Fri 20.
   - If he is out, add **Derik Queen** for the same game.
3. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his game vs NY ends (tip-off Fri 20, 12:00 PM). Add **Quentin Grimes** before LAL vs SAC (Sat 21, 2:00 PM).
   - Only if Austin Reaves is out; otherwise add **Aday Mara** before OKC vs NO (Sat 21, 12:00 PM).
4. **21 Nov:** drop Grimes or Mara after their game. Add **Neemias Queta** before BOS @SAC (Sun 22, 2:00 PM).
5. **22 Nov:** drop Murphy or Queen after their game at SA. Add **Matas Buzelis** (CHI vs DEN) before Mon 23, 11:00 AM.

**Projection by outcome** (lineup over 19–22 Nov, then the final; they score 864 more):
- **Every check passes:** +133.1, about **1,827 to 1,641**.
- **Murphy out:** +119.1, about 1,813 to 1,641.
- **Murphy and Grimes out:** +115.3, about 1,809 to 1,641.

**Risk:** Cade Cunningham and Scottie Barnes, both *ESPN est.* 20 Nov. Cunningham "will presumably be back" Friday ([CBS/RotoWire, 18 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-cade-cunningham-ruled-out-wednesday-539841/)).
